{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Patient IDs with multiple rows: {list(duplicates.index)}')"}
